b01-bakery.observed_description: A small brick bakery on a cobbled street; its big arched window is full of loaves, rolls and baguettes, and a baker in a white apron and cap stands in the doorway holding a basket of baguettes.
b01-bakery.note: Usable: reads instantly as a bakery at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no writing.

b02-bookstore.observed_description: A white-fronted bookstore; the window shows rows of plain-colored books and tall shelves of books inside, where a grey-haired woman in a red top reads an open book.
b02-bookstore.note: Usable: reads as a bookstore at 180 px; covers carry no writing.

b03-police.observed_description: A two-story red-brick building with a white police car (blue stripe, light bar) parked in front and a uniformed police officer standing by the steps.
b03-police.note: Usable: the police car and officer make it a police station at 360 px; the car's small door emblem has no readable text; in the 4:5 crop the car and officer stay.

b04-gas.observed_description: Luis in his navy T-shirt stands under a gas-station roof by his red car and holds the fuel nozzle in its tank; the gas pump stands at the right edge.
b04-gas.note: Usable: filling the car at a gas station reads at 180 px; Luis matches A1+ 2.2's driver; the pump's small labels are unreadable at runtime size.
